effects: The vault pulls exactly `amount` of the collateral token rsLSK-OFT (0x1e6b0ff8…, set at initialization and matching the descriptor constant) from the signer with safeTransferFrom (Vault.deposit).
Vault active shares, priced from the vault's current stake, are credited to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily to the signer (`_activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`).
The call reverts if a depositor whitelist is on and the signer is not on it, or if the deposit limit would be passed.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 rsLSK-OFT for <beneficiary>, with the vault, the amount in rsLSK-OFT and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown because it comes from the vault's stored stake and shares.
findings.evidence: Vault.deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)` reads storage. No calldata value carries it.
findings.fix: None possible. The beneficiary and the amount of collateral are already shown.

effects: The signer's active shares are burned, rounded up from `amount` of collateral (previewWithdraw, Ceil). No tokens move in this call.
A withdrawal claim on `amount` rsLSK-OFT for epoch currentEpoch+1 is credited to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it later, so the signer gives up the stake when `claimer` is someone else.
Until it is claimed, the queued amount can still be slashed, and it can only be claimed after the next epoch ends (the epoch is 7 days for this vault).
formats.shown: Request 2.5 rsLSK-OFT withdrawal for <claimer>, with the vault, the requested assets in rsLSK-OFT and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned, the claim epoch and the slashing risk come from storage and are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. Vault._withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1`. onSlash can reduce `withdrawals[epoch]`.
findings.fix: None needed in fields. The intent 'Request withdrawal' already says the funds do not arrive now.

effects: `shares` of the signer's active vault shares are burned.
The rsLSK-OFT value of those shares at the current price becomes a withdrawal claim for epoch currentEpoch+1, credited to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it later.
No tokens move now. The claim can be slashed until it is claimed after the next epoch.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for <claimer>, with the vault, the raw share count and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw integer with no decimals, though shares use the collateral's scale.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` has format `raw`. Case 2 shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares have the same decimals as rsLSK-OFT (18).
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with `decimals: 18` and `base: "shares"` (or label it 'Vault shares'), so that it reads 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the collateral the shares are worth is priced from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: The signer's matured withdrawal for `epoch` is marked as claimed.
The whole withdrawal the signer is owed for that epoch, in rsLSK-OFT (amount read from storage), is sent to `recipient`, who may not be the signer.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to <recipient>, with the vault, the epoch and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claim: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (rsLSK-OFT).
findings.evidence: Vault.claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}' do not mention the token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim rsLSK-OFT withdrawal', with interpolatedIntent 'Claim rsLSK-OFT from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not in the calldata.

effects: Every listed epoch's withdrawal for the signer is marked as claimed. The call reverts if any of them is not mature, was already claimed, or is empty.
The sum of those withdrawals, in rsLSK-OFT (amounts read from storage), is sent to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42 and 44 and 128 to <recipient>, with the vault, each epoch and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claimBatch: no part of the screen names the asset paid out (rsLSK-OFT).
findings.evidence: Vault.claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals' and interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}' do not mention the token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim rsLSK-OFT withdrawals'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total sent to the recipient is summed from storage and is not in the calldata.
